description.zh: 把 Harness 调成干净的白纸界面：纯白画布、暖调中性文字、统一的控件形状与间距、有信息量的动效；超长用户消息折叠成 20 行、原位展开。插件关闭后精确回到出厂外观。
description.en: Turns Harness into a clean paper-like surface: white canvas, warm neutral text, unified control shapes and spacing, motion that carries information, and long user messages folded to 20 lines with in-place disclosure. Disabling it restores the shipped interface exactly.
